110:   rw [Unitary.mem_iff]
111:   constructor <;> rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]

45: /-- o estado do canal de espelhamento: ℂ² = (atravessar, refletir). -/
46: abbrev MirrorState : Type := Fin 2 → ℂ
47: 
48: /-- a rotação do divisor de feixe: R(θ) — a face unitária da regra. -/
49: def beamRotation (θ : ℝ) : MirrorState → MirrorState := fun ψ i =>
50:   if i = 0 then (Real.cos θ : ℂ) * ψ 0 - (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * ψ 1
51:   else (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * ψ 0 + (Real.cos θ : ℂ) * ψ 1
52: 
53: /-- [KERNEL] ★★ A REGRA DA COEXISTÊNCIA: a rotação preserva a soma dos
54:     pesos — as possibilidades coexistem porque fecham no Um
55:     (cos²θ + sin²θ = 1 = ω(I); a unitariedade do espelho). -/
56: theorem beamRotation_preserves (θ : ℝ) (ψ : MirrorState) :
57:     Complex.normSq (beamRotation θ ψ 0) + Complex.normSq (beamRotation θ ψ 1)
58:       = Complex.normSq (ψ 0) + Complex.normSq (ψ 1) := by

175: /-- O SEMIGRUPO NO REFERENCIAL DA MATRIZ-S:
176:     `T^S_t = Ad(Sᴴ)∘D_t∘Ad(S)` — o encaixe exato das duas pontas já
177:     provadas no kernel (matriz-S v41 + dephasing v43). -/
178: def sFrame (θ : ℝ) (g : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
179:     (x : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
180:   (Smat θ)ᴴ * dephase g t (Smat θ * x * (Smat θ)ᴴ) * Smat θ
181: 
182: /-- `T^S_0 = id`. -/
183: theorem sFrame_zero (θ : ℝ) (g : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
184:     (x : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : sFrame θ g 0 x = x := by
185:   unfold sFrame
186:   rw [dephase_zero]
187:   simp only [← mul_assoc]
188:   rw [Smat_conjTranspose_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, Smat_conjTranspose_mul, mul_one]
189: 
190: /-- [KERNEL] LEI DE SEMIGRUPO NO REFERENCIAL-S: `T^S_{s+t} = T^S_s∘T^S_t`
191:     — a composição v41+v43 é um semigrupo GENUÍNO (a família de medição
192:     `D_t∘Ad(S)` sozinha não é; o referencial-S conserta). -/
193: theorem sFrame_add (θ : ℝ) (g : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (s t : ℝ)
194:     (x : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
195:     sFrame θ g (s + t) x = sFrame θ g s (sFrame θ g t x) := by
196:   unfold sFrame
197:   have hinner : Smat θ * ((Smat θ)ᴴ * dephase g t (Smat θ * x * (Smat θ)ᴴ) * Smat θ)
198:         * (Smat θ)ᴴ
199:       = dephase g t (Smat θ * x * (Smat θ)ᴴ) := by
200:     simp only [← mul_assoc]
201:     rw [Smat_mul_conjTranspose, one_mul, mul_assoc, Smat_mul_conjTranspose, mul_one]
202:   rw [hinner, ← dephase_add]
203: 
204: /-- [KERNEL] CONVERGÊNCIA NO REFERENCIAL-S:
205:     `T^S_t(x) → Ad(Sᴴ)∘E_D∘Ad(S)(x)` — o semigrupo composto converge
206:     para a esperança condicional comprimida pelo canal: U (matriz-S) +
207:     T1 (dephasing) = canal modular de medição. -/
208: theorem sFrame_tendsto (θ : ℝ) (g : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hg0 : ∀ i, g i i = 0)
209:     (hgpos : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 < g i j) (x : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
210:     Tendsto (fun t => sFrame θ g t x) atTop
211:       (nhds ((Smat θ)ᴴ * diagExpect (Smat θ * x * (Smat θ)ᴴ) * Smat θ)) := by
212:   have h := dephase_tendsto_expectation g hg0 hgpos (Smat θ * x * (Smat θ)ᴴ)
213:   have hcont : Continuous fun y : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ => (Smat θ)ᴴ * y * Smat θ :=
214:     (continuous_const.matrix_mul continuous_id).matrix_mul continuous_const
215:   exact ((hcont.tendsto _).comp h : _)

110:     (hsa : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T = T) (q : Polynomial ℂ)
111:     (hann : aeval T (X * q) = 0) (hc : q.coeff 0 ≠ 0)

104: noncomputable def axiomFlow (P : A) (t : ℝ) : A := P + ((Real.exp (-t) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 - P)
105: 
106: theorem post_mul_compl {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) : P * (1 - P) = 0 := by
107:   rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hP.eq, sub_self]
108: 
109: theorem compl_mul_post {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) : (1 - P) * P = 0 := by

120: theorem axiomFlow_add {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (s t : ℝ) :
121:     axiomFlow P (s + t) = axiomFlow P s * axiomFlow P t := by
122:   unfold axiomFlow
123:   rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, hP.eq, mul_smul_comm, post_mul_compl hP, smul_zero, add_zero,
124:     smul_mul_assoc, compl_mul_post hP, smul_zero, zero_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, compl_mul_compl hP,
125:     smul_smul, neg_add, Real.exp_add, Complex.ofReal_mul]
126: 
127: /-- ★★★ O POSTO ESTÁ ESTACIONADO desde t = 0 — não se ascende a ele: F(t)·P = P e P·F(t) = P, para todo t. -/
128: theorem axiomFlow_fixes_the_post {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (t : ℝ) :
129:     axiomFlow P t * P = P ∧ P * axiomFlow P t = P := by
130:   unfold axiomFlow
131:   refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
132:   · rw [add_mul, hP.eq, smul_mul_assoc, compl_mul_post hP, smul_zero, add_zero]
133:   · rw [mul_add, hP.eq, mul_smul_comm, post_mul_compl hP, smul_zero, add_zero]
134: 
135: /-- ★★★ O GRADIENTE DE ESPECTRO NEGATIVO nasce do posto, no complemento dele: F(t)·(1 − P) = e^{−t}(1 − P). -/
136: theorem axiomFlow_gradient {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (t : ℝ) :
137:     axiomFlow P t * (1 - P) = ((Real.exp (-t) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 - P) := by
138:   unfold axiomFlow
139:   rw [add_mul, post_mul_compl hP, zero_add, smul_mul_assoc, compl_mul_compl hP]
140: 
141: end Flow
142: 
143: /-- ★★★ A LEITURA POUSA NO POSTO: F(t) → P quando t → ∞. -/
144: theorem axiomFlow_tendsto_the_post {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (P : A) :
145:     Tendsto (axiomFlow P) atTop (𝓝 P) := by
146:   have h1 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
147:     have h := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero
148:     rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at h
149:     exact h
150:   have h2 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((Real.exp (-t) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 - P)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
151:     have h := h1.smul_const (1 - P)
152:     rw [zero_smul] at h
153:     exact h
154:   have h3 := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := P)).add h2
155:   rw [add_zero] at h3
156:   exact h3

158: /-- ★★ A FORMA EXPONENCIAL: `F(t) = e^{−t·H_min}`, `H_min = 1 − P` (P idempotente) — a FIAÇÃO ao termo canônico já auditado

161: theorem axiomFlow_eq_exp {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] [CompleteSpace A]
162:     {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (t : ℝ) :
163:     NormedSpace.exp ((-t) • (1 - P)) = axiomFlow P t := by
164:   rw [ORDEM016.EquationOfTruth.IdempotentDephasing.exp_complement_idempotent P hP.eq t]

122: def canonical_H(d, nc, eps):
123:     """H_LD no setor de uma excitacao, como build_system(seed=42) do validador C3 v5.2: mu, J (RandomState(42)), -eps*Pi."""
124:     mu = np.zeros(d)
125:     mu[:nc] = -1.0 * np.arange(nc, 0, -1)
126:     mu[nc:] = 0.5 + 0.3 * np.arange(d - nc)
127:     rs = np.random.RandomState(42)
128:     J = rs.randn(d, d) * 0.2
129:     J = (J + J.T) / 2.0
130:     np.fill_diagonal(J, 0.0)
131:     J[:nc, :nc] *= 2.0
132:     Pi = np.zeros((d, d)); Pi[:nc, :nc] = np.eye(nc)
133:     H = np.diag(mu) + J - eps * Pi
134:     H = (H + H.T) / 2.0
135:     return H.astype(complex), Pi.astype(complex)
